StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Authenticated student profile, onboarding state (Student Name and Target Exam), and aggregated progress tracker metrics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student owner.

studentName.description: Full name entered by the student on the dashboard setup.

targetExam.description: Primary competitive exam the student is preparing for (e.g., IIT JEE, NEET UG, UGC NET, CTET / TET).

authMethod.description: Authentication method used by the student.

totalPoints.description: Total XP / score points earned across quizzes and mock tests.

testsAttempted.description: Total number of mock tests completed by the student.

averageAccuracy.description: Overall accuracy percentage (0 to 100) across attempted tests.

streakDays.description: Current consecutive daily quiz streak count.

accountSetupCompleted.description: Whether the student has completed the 2-field dashboard onboarding (Student Name + Target Exam).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TestAttemptRecord.title: TestAttemptRecord
TestAttemptRecord.description: Individual mock test attempt record stored under a student's profile for progress tracking.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who attempted the test.

testId.description: Identifier of the attempted mock test.

testTitle.description: Title of the attempted mock test.

examCategory.description: Exam category of the attempted test (e.g., IIT JEE, NEET, UGC NET, TET).

score.description: Score achieved in the test attempt.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the test.

accuracyPercent.description: Accuracy percentage (0 to 100) for this attempt.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was recorded. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt record was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

QuizTestDocument.title: QuizTestDocument
QuizTestDocument.description: Firestore quiz test metadata and configuration fetched by QuizViewModel for multi-choice quizzes.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student accessing or syncing the quiz test.

testId.description: Unique identifier of the quiz or mock test.

examKey.description: Exam category key (e.g., upsc, up_police, ssc, iit_jee, neet, ugc_net, tet).

questionCount.description: Total number of questions in the test.

paidOnly.description: Whether this test belongs to the Paid Test Series section.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the quiz test document was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the quiz test document was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserSubscription.title: UserSubscription
UserSubscription.description: User subscription status stored in Firestore for gating access to Paid Test Series features (Monthly ₹9, Yearly ₹99, or Lifetime ₹399).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the subscribed user.

planName.description: Display name of the subscription plan.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the user's subscription.

active.description: Whether the subscription is currently active and unlocks Paid Test Series.

startEpochMillis.description: Subscription activation timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

expiryEpochMillis.description: Subscription expiration timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription record was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription record was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/students/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated student's profile, target exam, and aggregated progress tracker metrics.

/students/{userId}/test_attempts/{attemp.description: Stores user-scoped test attempt history for the student's progress tracker.

/students/{userId}/quiz_tests/{testId}.description: Stores user-scoped quiz test metadata fetched and synchronized by QuizViewModel.

/subscriptions/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's active subscription plan (Monthly ₹9, Yearly ₹99, Lifetime ₹399) to gate access to Paid Test Series features.
